UPDATE 4/29/2026

Below are common questions which have been received regarding this requirement, along with corresponding answers: 

Q. The SOW states the contractor shall provide cleaning and waste emptying "as needed" for 100 people. Can the Government provide a minimum required frequency for cleaning and pumping (e.g., three times per week, daily)? 

          A. This would depend on size of waste tank on the unit.  Vendor experience should determine frequency of service and be included with their bid.  The unit should remain usable during the entire POP. 

Q. Does the contractor's responsibility for "maintenance and upkeep" include the provision of all consumables (toilet paper, paper towels, soap, and hand sanitizer) for the duration of the rental? 

          A. Yes, consumable included with the rental

Q. Power Distance: What is the approximate distance from the trailer’s intended placement to the 110v AC electrical outlet? (This determines the length of the contractor-provided extension cord required). 

          A. Electrical hookup (110v) will be maximum of 100 ft from trailer.

Q. Water Connection: What is the distance from the trailer to the 1 ½ inch freshwater connection?

           A. Water hookup will be maximum of 100 ft from trailer.

Q. The current SOW specifies an "all-weather full enclosure" and requires electrical connectivity, but does not explicitly state a requirement for Air Conditioning (AC) or climate control. Does the Government require the trailer to be equipped with active Climate Control/Air Conditioning to meet the "all-weather" and "24-hour use" requirements? 

           A. Yes.

Q. Will water be provided by the government?

            A. Yes, a water connection (1.5 inch firehose connection) is available. Vendor bring hoses/adapters and connect.

Q. Is there a dumping facility we can use on site? 

            A. No.

Q. How often do you expect cleaning and restocking to be needed? 

            A. Expected usage is 100 people 24/7.

This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for a commercial service acquisition prepared in accordance with simplified acquisition procedures found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Revolutionary Far Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 12.2, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. This solicitation is intended to result in the issuance of a singular firm fixed price award.

Solicitation Number N62789-26-Q-0019 is issued as a request for quotation (RFQ).  The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular FAC 2026-01 dated March 13, 2026.

This is a complete small business set aside acquisition using NAICS Code: 562991, size standard: $9,000,000.

The unit will be used at a pier at the Naval Submarine Base New London. The intended period of performance is May 26, 2026 – July 20, 2026.

The successful offeror is also required to be at least “LEVEL 1; SELF” Certified in the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) within the Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) module in the Procurement Integrated Enterprise Environment (PIEE). This requirement is found in DFARS Provision 252.204-7025 and Clause 252.204-7021 as both are contained in the solicitation.

Please provide a quote stating the total price of the work and further broken down by Contract Line Item Number (CLIN). Please include as much detail as possible to assist in an expeditious evaluation.

CLIN 0001: Portable Restroom Trailer The Contractor shall provide one (1) Portable Restroom trailer with a minimum of four (4) separate (unisex) stalls with a minimum of two (2) hand wash sinks. Please see statement of work for specific requirements.

CLIN 0002: Delivery and Pick-Up Round Trip Delivery/Pick-up to (Naval Submarine Gase, Groton, CT)for the portable restroom. Delivery and pick-up date and time shall be coordinated with the Government Technical Point of Contact (GTPOC).

CONTRACTOR TO PROVIDE A QUOTE BROKEN DOWN IN THE FOLLOWING MANNER:

DAILY RATE: $X.XX

WEEKLY RATE: $X.XX

MONTHLY RATE: $X.XX

DELIVERY/PICK-UP CHARGE: $X.XX

TOTAL COST: $X.XX.

If delivery and pick up charges are included in the total cost of the quote, the quote shall adequately state that. Offerors shall submit the specification of the mobile restrooms and wash stations along with their quote.

The anticipated award will be made to the responsible vendor that can satisfy this requirement in conformance with the solicitation and is determined to be the best value to the government, price and other factors considered. In determining the best overall response, the combined non-cost/price factors (technical qualification and past performance) are more important than the cost/price factor; however, cost/price is still a significant factor. The Government may select for award the offeror whose price is not necessarily the lowest, but whose technical quotation is more advantageous to the Government and warrants the additional cost. Offers that take exception to any performance criteria are unacceptable.

Quotations are due prior to 04:00 P.M., EST on May 8th, 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted.

Offers should be submitted via electronic mail to: roland.j.parrilla.civ@us.navy.mil and stephanie.l.neale.civ@us.navy.mil. Offerors should identify the RFQ number in the subject line of the email. Offerors are advised to submit electronic documents early and to confirm successful transmittal.

The System for Award Management (SAM) is a Government maintained database of companies wanting to do business with the Government. A firm must register and maintain an active SAM registration in order to receive a federal award. Register at: https://sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/index.jsf

EVALUATION FACTORS FOR AWARD:

Quotes will be evaluated for technical acceptability and price. The Government may select for award the offeror whose price is not necessarily the lowest, but whose technical quotation is more advantageous to the Government and warrants the additional cost.
